title: Initial App Launch
details: App renders modern dark-mode branding with email and password fields.

title: User Registration View
details: Shows Email, Password (min 12 chars requirement), and Confirm Password.
uxIssue: Clear requirements and responsive input fields.

title: AI-First Main Dashboard
details: Greets user with prominent AI Travel Planner hero card, prompt inspiration chips (Mysore, Goa, Manali), quick stats, and Recent Trips.
uxIssue: EXCELLENT AI ENTRY: Users can immediately type a dream trip or tap an inspiration prompt chip.

title: Unified AI Trip Planning Form
details: Single unified flow collecting Destination, Duration in Days, Target Budget, Travel Style, Interests, and Special Notes.
uxIssue: SEAMLESS TRAVELER UX: Replaces blank metadata dialog with natural travel planning inputs.

title: Preferences Configured
details: Configured: Mysore, India 822, 3 days, ₹15,000 budget, Balanced style, History/Food interests, and special food requests.
uxIssue: Intuitive form with preselected defaults and visual style chips.

title: Traveler-Friendly AI Travel Plan
details: Shows AI Concept Summary, Travel Pace, Estimated Budget, and Day-by-Day schedule with verified places and zero raw UUIDs.
uxIssue: EXCELLENT PRESENTATION: Technical proposal terminology replaced with genuine travel plan layout.

title: Detailed Daily Stops & Timing
details: Shows verified Mysore venues (Palace, Mylari dosa, Chamundi Hill), time slots, durations, category badges, and notes.
uxIssue: Prominent "Save to My Trip" CTA pinned at bottom.

title: Traveler-First Trip Hub
details: Features Hero Header (Status: PLANNED), Today/Next Activity highlight, Itinerary preview, AI Travel Copilot card, Budget gauge (₹15,000 limit), and collapsed Trip Tools.
uxIssue: HUGE UX IMPROVEMENT: Clean, prioritized traveler essentials; developer UUIDs and separate 7-module clutter removed.

title: Recent Trips with Planned Status
details: New Mysore trip appears under Recent Trips with "PLANNED" badge, 3 days duration, and direct entry.

title: Daily Timeline View
details: Materialized schedule showing Day tabs (Day 1, Day 2, Day 3), time slots, activities, and travel notes.
uxIssue: Complete verified stops with time allocations.

title: Conversational Copilot Interface
details: Features quick prompt chips ("Check schedule conflicts", "Estimate travel time"), travel warning banner, and message input.

title: Schedule Intelligence Response
details: AI Assistant analyzes current itinerary schedule and verifies timing conflicts.
uxIssue: Assistant answers conversationally, citing the generated itinerary state.

title: Travel Feasibility & Time Breakdown
details: AI Assistant estimates inter-stop travel durations across Day 1, 2, and 3.

title: Auto-Initialized Budget Tracker
details: Shows ₹15,000 Total Budget limit automatically created from AI planning proposal, spent gauge, and category breakdowns.
uxIssue: ZERO REDUNDANT SETUP: Budget was initialized seamlessly upon saving AI plan.

title: Members & Sharing Link
details: Shows Owner status, Invite Collaborator button, Share Link generator, and Member roles (Owner, Editor, Viewer).

title: Notification Settings
details: Granular switches for Schedule Changes, Travel Advisories, Collaborator Activity, and Quiet Hours settings.

title: Trip Activity Stream
details: Chronological list of all actions performed on the trip (trip created, proposal requested, proposal accepted, itinerary populated, budget created).

title: Photo & Attachment Gallery
details: Traveler guidance empty state with "Add Media" button, category filters (All, Photos, Receipts, Tickets), and storage gauge.
uxIssue: Engaging empty state with clear instructions.

title: Complete Planned Journey Hub
details: Status badge is "PLANNED", hero highlights destination and date count, upcoming activity is ready, budget progress is tracking, and tools are available.
uxIssue: EXCELLENT AI-FIRST EXPERIENCE: End-to-end trip creation in under 30 seconds.
